label: For "Order Fallout Resolution Agent": Diagnose a fallout order from system errors and order history, apply approved low-risk fixes and prepare a complete handoff for the rest, so human fallout handlers focus on hard cases. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Counting closed tickets as fixed.
